scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
issuing_authority: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
target_group: Individuals aged 18 to 50 years with a bank or post office savings account giving consent for auto-debit

eligibility_rules.description: Maintains an operational bank account with Aadhaar linking
Possesses Aadhaar as primary KYC document

benefits.amount: Rs 2,00,000 payable to nominee on death of member due to any cause
benefits.instalments: Nominal premium of Rs 436 per year auto-debited in one instalment

application_steps: Login to your bank's net-banking portal or visit your local branch / post office
Submit the simple one-page PMJJBY consent-cum-declaration form for auto-debit of Rs 436/year
Receive instant Certificate of Insurance via SMS/email
source_document: PMJJBY Scheme Rules, Department of Financial Services
